GAB.note: ARTAC statutes are the body's own rules, not shared digital law taken into national law.

facts.fact: The Agence Gabonaise de Presse reports that ARTAC, the Central African telecoms regulators' assembly, held its fourth extraordinary session in Libreville, closing on 21 October 2026, with thanks to the Gabonese government and ARCEP Gabon for hosting.
